nom: Avène Hyaluron Activ B3 Concentrated Plumping Serum

avis.texte: I bought this because I am a hig fan of avene and love the extra hydration of a B3; however, i was SHOCKED when I opened it and it had fragrance. Very strong and very irritating, because of this I have lost trust in this brand as a credible one for skin care, as most yupixally wont have a formula with fragrance.
After 2 weeks of using I do notice my skin looking more youthful and less flat and dull! As someone with acne scars it seems to be helping too!
I was so scared to try this on my sensitive rosacea skin, but let me tell you my skin drank this up! It has made such a huge difference in helping my skin glow and be more plump! 10/10

I am 46 years old and have maturing , sensitive skin. After much research and a recommendation from my dermatologist I discovered this holy grail product. I have repurchased this twice now and it will always be a staple in my skin care routine. It contains both hyaluronic acid AND niacinamide in one simple step. It is fragrance free and very gentle. Skin feels immediately hydrated and noticeably more plump. Times when I have been sick and didnt use this twice daily, there was a significant difference in my skin. It starts off your whole skin care routine right and makes everything after (should you choose to wear makeup) on the best possible path. I recommend this to all my friends & family and they have all loved it as much as I do! You cannot go wrong with this product.
I got a sample and will say my skin is noticeably better + more hydrated. it feels more gentle then retinol cream - I think I will ne purchasing to try.

I bought this based on a YouTube Derm's recommendation when I was looking for a Kate Somerville dupe. This is it l, though I find the Avene to be a superior product. It also costs sixty dollars less. I use this over vitc,and under sunscreen and makeup. I don't need any primer, this product takes care of all that and doesn't leave me with too many products on my face. It does initially sink in quickly so don't take your time blending it in. It will not pill. Start with a smaller drop as it goes a long way. I also use it on the backs of my hands under sunblock where my age REALLY shows and it pumps everything right up.
Not sure what happened with my last comment but it should have been zero stars not 5. Not for sensitive skin i also got a rash on my cheeks
I tried this serum twice and realized its behind the rash ive been getting on my cheekbones. Such a shame because it feels great going on. If you have sensitive skin i would definitely pass on it.

This plumps and rehydrates my skin without burning or stinging. I saw noticeable results in less than a week, and a significant reduction in my pore size in less than a month. Sounds unbelievable but it's true. Photo is before/after 60 days of use

This brightens my hyperpigmentation from my acne scars and hydrates deep within my skin. I get laser treatment occasionally and I always switch to just this product and moisturizing cream because it's ultra sensitive and it works wonders.
This product is amazing, I will always stay stocked with it !

avis.titre: Love this as a first layered product!
avis.texte: My dermatologist told me that I needed to go back to the VERY basics after I had a huge allergic reaction to some Biossance product I was using. I was excited to try this before the Avene Cicalfate+ Restorative Protective Cream in my regmine, have been using for about 2 weeks. My 4 steps are: Thermal Water Spray, this glorious Hyaluron + Cicalfate Cream + Biossance Rose Oil and my skin is SUPPLE, not red or irritated. Looks and feels amazing!

This product is nice, but I keep getting a reaction on my cheek bones and under eyes. I stopped using and saw improvement in my skin, and resumed it just for it to happen again. I find it to be a delayed reaction, where the rash comes after a week of use. This is the only product I keep adding and removing from my regimen which leads me to believe that it is the culprit.
I am in love with this product line. Avene never leaves greasy films on my skin and is very kind to my sensitive skin. I've noticed results in one week since starting

Absolutely love it. I have been using once a day, in the mornings, before moisturizer and sunscreen. I noticed a plumping and hydrating effect right away, and over a month, I've been an improvement in skin texture and softness, and help with fine lines and wrinkles. Amazing product. Love that it's fragrance free!

While I've been using Avene products for years and have always been thrilled with the results, this new serum caused a severe rash on my cheekbone/under eye area. After reading further, the Niacinamide is an ingredient that is known to cause this reaction. Definitely do not recommend and am hoping my face starts to clear up soon.
I'm using the Hyaluron Activ B3 for the first time and I really like it. Very hydrating.
Leaves skin feeling plump and hydrated. Does not irritate my sensitive skin.
i use it daily in the morning for the past two month. Hard to tell if my skin see any improvement. But i like it how it smooths on my skin. I will continue to use

Sadly this is not the right product for me. I have sensitive skin but not overly reactive. This serum gave me contact dermatitis. For those interested, the serum is lightweight and sinks in easily but I could not use it long enough to determine results.

I used this product in conjunction with Multi intensive night cream and Renewal firming cream for the past 2 weeks. I like that they work together complimenting each other and included the neck and surrounding area. I found that I definitely needed two drops and maybe a bit more to cover the face, neck and surrounding neck area. The results were seen and felt over time with my face, neck and surrounding neck area feeling much firmer and smooth. I did not like the sticky feeling but that was rapidly replaced with the renewal firming cream application. I was gifted a product sample to trial and review.

This serum is thicker than the SkinCeuticals B5 gel but absorbs faster and keeps my skin hydrated longer without breakouts. I do not use it with my Vit C serum as B3 and. It C don't always get along, but I use this every night before my Tretinoin and NO redness or flaking. Just so happy to have found clean products that aren't triple the price.
